svg.text: Figure 3-8 · PFMEA structure and function tree
PFM rev 0.4 · BL-007 · draft · AIAG-VDA steps 2–3: structure elements by level, functions of each element
R1 Freeze and pin the baseline
Freeze every component of the release at an identified, protected version
R2 Build the release (host tree, panda
Produce the release artifacts, including a panda RELEASE build with the LionDriver key and the reference lock
R3 Verify and assemble the evidence
Run and archive all required verification on the exact release commit
Publish only the approved release through the LionDriver channel
Use only the approved, undamaged device and harness
Install only on a vehicle that is in the reference configuration and healthy
Mount the device and connect the harness so that the CAN path, relay and camera view are as designed
Provision the released software, panda firmware, models and parameter set
Confirm that the item identifies the vehicle as the reference configuration and runs the reference safety mode
Calibrate, prove the stock PCS path and engagement transitions, and brief the driver
Update or roll back only to an approved release whose evidence is valid for the installed device
